verdict.rationale: Anrok has a filings API endpoint to fetch filings and marketing claims of dashboards showing tax obligations and 'filing and payments, done for you,' suggesting some filing visibility exists, but there is no evidence of a calendar view of upcoming returns, explicit per-filing status tracking, remitted amounts, or downloadable confirmations for submitted returns. missing for 10: calendar of upcoming returns, explicit per-filing status labels, remitted amount tracking, downloadable filing confirmations.
